author: mark
text:
v0.5 UI: pulsing indicators for in-flight tool calls

Tool-call view-model from <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<latest-NNN>/
tools/<tool-id>/{input,output}.json (ARCH §3.3): input present without
output ⇒ in-flight, both ⇒ complete. Renderer pulses in-flight nodes via
time-modulated alpha and ctx.request_repaint_after (~30 fps); complete
nodes paint statically.

Tests: disk-state unit tests (input only / both / mid-write race / sort
order), from_repo end-to-end populates ConversationBranch.tool_calls, and
render-time repaint_delay contract distinguishes in-flight vs complete vs
mixed branches.
